errors.evidence: The description states the y-axis range is from 40 to 140, which only describes the labeled range. The data for "Публични инвестиции" (Public Investments) reaches a peak of approximately 150 in 2015, which is outside this stated range.

errors.text_span: Частните инвестиции започват от 100 през 2007 г., достигат връх от 125 през 2008 г., след което спадат до около 72 през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: This description oversimplifies the trend for private investments by connecting the 2008 peak directly to the 2015 trough. It completely omits the major feature of a sharp drop between 2008 and 2010 (from ~124 to ~80) and the subsequent period of relative stability around the value of 80 between 2010 and 2014.
The value for public investments in 2011 is approximately 72, not 70. The minimum value in this period (2011-2012) is around 72.
